subject: Request: extend trial window and sandbox credits while integration team resolves webhook mismatch
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@clearpath.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integration stalled — asking for short trial extension + sandbox top-up

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We spun up the connector and started a first sync today, but our engineers hit a blocker: the incoming webhook schema from our ingestion pipeline has a nested timestamp field that doesn't match Redwood's expected event.time path. The devs are working through it but estimate a 7–10 day fix because it touches two downstream transforms.

We were hoping to avoid losing momentum with the product team — is it possible to get a 30‑day trial extension + an additional sandbox credit top‑up while we resolve the schema mismatch? I attached the ingestion logs and a screenshot of the schema diff.

Attachments: integration-log.txt (text), webhook-schema-diff.png (image)

If you need anything from our side (sample payloads or a short engineering call), happy to do that — we want to keep the POC timeline intact.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Product Manager, ClearPath Analytics
alyssa@clearpath.io
+1-415-555-0198

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@clearpath.io>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration stalled — asking for short trial extension + sandbox top-up

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the details and for attaching the logs. Sorry to hear about the schema mismatch; that kind of transform drift is common on first syncs but usually quick to resolve with a short tech pairing session.

I've looped in our AE and solutions engineer (see internal recipients) to request a 30‑day extension and a sandbox credit top‑up while your engineers finish the fix. Can you confirm two windows for a 30‑minute technical sync early next week (Mon/Tue morning PST)? Karthik, Lauren — can you review the logs Alyssa shared and advise on the appropriate sandbox/top‑up amount?

Proposed ask: 30 days extension + 10k token sandbox credit (temporary), contingent on a technical sync and a short success plan.

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Approval request — 30d extension + sandbox top-up for ClearPath (DEAL-7341)

Hi Lauren / Karthik,

Quick ask — ClearPath (DEAL-7341) hit an ingestion schema mismatch on first sync. External PM Alyssa attached logs and a schema screenshot; engineering expects a 7–10 day turnaround but they need runway to keep their product team and procurement engaged.

What I'm requesting from GTM:
- 30 calendar day trial extension (move end date forward)
- Temporary sandbox credit: 10,000 token-equivalent top-up
- Condition: ClearPath must schedule a 30-minute tech sync within 3 business days and agree to a short success plan (deliverables/milestones)

Why approve:
- Strong conversion signals (product team + procurement engaged, on a decision cycle for Q1 budget)
- Low-dollar uplift relative to deal value; extension dramatically increases chance of conversion
- We can gate the credit and extension on the technical sync + success plan so it's not open-ended

Attachments referenced: integration-log.txt, webhook-schema-diff.png, ClearPath_POI_SOW.pdf (pricing/POI)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7341

Suggested language for approval reply to customer (if you sign off):
"We can extend your sandbox for 30 days and issue a temporary 10k token top‑up. To unlock the extension we’ll set a technical pairing call this week and agree a short success plan — after that we’ll apply the credits and move the trial end date."

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Approval request — 30d extension + sandbox top-up for ClearPath (DEAL-7341)

Sofia — approve the ask with the conditions you outlined.

Approval details:
- 30 calendar day trial extension: APPROVED
- 10,000 token sandbox credit top-up: APPROVED (temporary, will be reclaimed if we don’t see the sync/success-plan within 10 business days)

Please do the following before replying to the customer:
1) Confirm two available 30‑minute slots for tech sync (Mon/Tue morning PST)
2) Attach the one‑pager success plan template (I’ll share ours)
3) Add a HubSpot note updating the trial end date and the credit line item (DEAL-7341)

Karthik — after approval please take the tech sync if you can; if not, loop Marcus or one of the SE team.

Lauren Bishop
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.ai
